name: Collateral Management
definition: Set of operations relative to the management of collateral, variation margins, default fund participation and independent amount.

CollateralProposal.name: Collateral Proposal
CollateralProposal.definition: Specifies collateral proposed to the counterparty.

CollateralValuation.name: Collateral Valuation
CollateralValuation.definition: Provides details about the valuation of each piece of collateral that is posted.

FeesAndCommissions.name: Fees And Commissions
FeesAndCommissions.definition: Specifies the amount of money paid for the provision of financial services.

InterestManagement.name: Interest Management
InterestManagement.definition: Calculation and request of interest linked to collateral.

DisputeManagement.name: Dispute Management
DisputeManagement.definition: Provides the dispute details on the variation margin and/or the segregated independent amount.

MarginCall.name: Margin Call
MarginCall.definition: Calculation of the  variation margin and independent amount needed to cover the risk exposure of one party versus another.

CollateralSubstitution.name: Collateral Substitution
CollateralSubstitution.definition: Request of a substitution of collateral by specifying the collateral to be returned and proposing the new type(s) of collateral to be delivered.

RiskToCover.name: Risk To Cover
RiskToCover.definition: Risk which is the source of the collateral management processes.

Collateral.name: Collateral
Collateral.definition: Description of the collateral which is related to the different management processes.

AgreedTerms.name: Agreed Terms
AgreedTerms.definition: Specifies the terms bilaterally agreed by the parties related to the collateral processes.

ClearingSystem.name: Clearing System
ClearingSystem.definition: Clearing system involved in the collateral management process.
